fact: The GPE KIX blog states that since its national launch in March 2024 Eswatini's PIN-driven EMIS covers all 976 primary and secondary schools, and that the EMIS still gives aggregate enrolment only: schools submit paper claim forms with each learner's PIN for the Free Primary Education grant, which is to be automated 'with the roll-out of SEMIS', and it refers to Eswatini's 'SEMIS pilots'.
title: South-South Collaboration for Stronger Education Systems: Lessons Learned from Cross-Country Learning Exchange and Knowledge Sharing
